liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (3 reviews): Listener calls the long, hot performance with sweet vocal jam possibly the best ever; Listener vividly remembers the Shakedown performance as a moment of pristine clarity [15][17][22]
- **Feel Like A Stranger** (1 review): Band comes out swinging from the first couple of licks of the song [18]
- **High Time** (1 review): Reviewer states the High Time performance alone makes the show a needed listen [19]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): First set is capped with a superb performance of Let It Grow [18]
- **Spanish Jam** (1 review): Reviewer describes the Spanish jam as sparkling during the rest of the show [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1981-05-16.sbd.miller.30647.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 178 min; rated 3.96/5 by 23 [1]
- **gd1981-05-16.175897.aud.bernstein.ackerman.noel.flac2496**: audience recording; 24 songs; 185 min [5]
- **gd81-05-16.wise.wiley.14714.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 174 min; rated 4.75/5 by 16 [10]. Said about its sound: Soundboard copy has perfect amount of background audience noise mixed in; Audience recording is preferred over clean soundboards due to Jerry firing majestically [15][19]
- **gd1981-05-16.fob-senn.wise-sacks.2212.shnf**: source not stated; 23 songs; 173 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [11]. Said about its sound: Master tape shows faint clicking and popping during quiet passages due to deterioration; A few analog dropouts occur during the second set of the recording [11]

## Around the show

- Attendee recalls a weird vibe in the air during the performance [17]
- Reviewer attended nine shows in the run, with this being the last as a junior [20]
- This source is a definite upgrade from the pre-existing FOB source [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-05-16.sbd.miller.30647.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Reel -> Dat, Set 2: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Dat [1]
- **gd1981-05-16.175897.aud.bernstein.ackerman.noel.flac2496**: taped by Master Cassettes Recorded by Jon Bernstein; transferred by Transfer, Mastering by Ray Ackerman Edited, Processed w/ add'l Mastering by Joe Noel January 07, 2025; source: ?? mics > ?? lead deck > ?? Deck > Master Cassettes [5]. Also: All tape flips were crossfaded during the transfer process [5]
- **gd81-05-16.wise.wiley.14714.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jim Wise, Eddie Claridge; source: Audience Recording [10]
- **gd1981-05-16.fob-senn.wise-sacks.2212.shnf**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by Darrin Sacks; source: FOB> 3 Sennheiser 421 mics > Nakamichi 550 > directly to disc via HHb 800 burner (via Jim Wise). [11]

## Art and photos

- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 5/16/81 Barton Hall - Cornell Univ…](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27366627195/) [28]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27366627195/) [29]
